What I'm looking for is a $189 refund, a $50 credit on top, the replacement sent out expedited and your word that you'll do the same if it happens again.

If this isn't resolved today I'll file a chargeback with my bank and let them handle it. The card company tends to side with the customer on these, as you know.

*   **Goodwill Credit:** I have added a $25 credit to your account. Please note that $25 is the maximum goodwill credit available on our policy for this type of resolution. I'm sorry I cannot provide the additional request amount you mentioned.

We want to avoid this necessarily, so I will not need to file any discrepancy unless the issue remains or if a third-party dispute is initiated in good faith. We'll ensure this gets resolved properly now.
